source_context:
CSC442
COMPUTATIONAL BIOLOGY AND INTERDISCIPLINARY STUDIES
MOODLE 3
SEQUENCE ANALYSIS WITH PYTHON
1) Writing Python programs for simple sequence analysis tasks (1)
Write a unique program that
1) accepts a string of nucleotide-sequence, finds the total number of nucleotides
that form the sequence, and calculates the percentage nucleotide composition of the
sequence
2) processes a file of nucleotide-sequence, finds the total number of nucleotides that
form the sequence, and calculates the percentage nucleotide composition of the
sequence.
You are to submit your codes with detailed screenshots in a single ms-word file.
2) Writing Python programs for simple sequence analysis tasks (2)
Write a unique program that
1) accepts a string of nucleotide-sequence and outputs the type of sequence it is, be
it DNA or mRNA
2) processes a file of nucleotide-sequence and outputs the type of sequence it is, be
it DNA or mRNA
3) If it is a DNA sequence, your program should transcribe it into an RNA and print
out both sequences.
4) If it is an RNA sequence, your program should do reverse transcription of the
sequence into a DNA and print out both sequences.
